name: Cloudflare R2
tax_note: Cloudflare billing policy: 'Cloudflare also collects sales tax as governed by local laws', computed from the billing or shipping address; the R2 pricing page does not say whether listed prices include tax.

regions.note: S3 API region is always 'auto' (empty and us-east-1 alias to auto). Bucket location is chosen automatically near the creator or by a location hint (wnam, enam, weur, eeur, apac, oc); a jurisdiction (eu, fedramp, us) guarantees residency and uses its own endpoint. Country ZZ = not a single country (schema requires a code).

storage_classes.name: Standard

price.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Standard storage: $0.015 / GB-month (GB-month = average of daily peak storage over 30 days; usage rounded up to the next billing unit). One global price; no regional price list. First 10 GB-month free (see free_tier).

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Standard storage: $4.50 per million Class A operations, converted to per 1,000. PutObject, CopyObject, multipart parts are Class A.

get_per_1000.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Standard storage: $0.36 per million Class B operations, converted to per 1,000. GetObject and HeadObject are Class B.

list_per_1000.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Standard storage: $4.50 per million Class A operations, converted to per 1,000. ListObjects and ListBuckets are Class A.

price_per_gb.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Standard storage: Data Retrieval (processing) 'None'.

typical_delay.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing page, minimum storage duration table: Standard storage 'None'.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Storage classes page: all classes have 'No minimum object size'.

notes: S3 storage class header value STANDARD (S3 API compatibility page). Default class for new buckets unless set otherwise.
DeleteObject, DeleteBucket and AbortMultipartUpload are free operations.
Usage is rounded up to the next billing unit (for example 1,000,001 operations are billed as 2 million).

storage_classes.name: Infrequent Access

price.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Infrequent Access storage: $0.01 / GB-month. The free tier does not apply to this class.

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Infrequent Access storage: $9.00 per million Class A operations, converted to per 1,000. PutObject, CopyObject, multipart parts are Class A.

get_per_1000.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Infrequent Access storage: $0.90 per million Class B operations, converted to per 1,000. GetObject and HeadObject are Class B.

list_per_1000.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Infrequent Access storage: $9.00 per million Class A operations, converted to per 1,000. ListObjects and ListBuckets are Class A.

price_per_gb.note: Pricing page (last updated Oct 1, 2026), Infrequent Access storage: Data Retrieval (processing) $0.01 / GB; applies whenever objects are read or copied.

typical_delay.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing page: Infrequent Access minimum storage duration 30 days; objects deleted, moved or replaced earlier are charged for the full duration.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Storage classes page: all classes have 'No minimum object size'.

notes: S3 storage class header value STANDARD_IA (S3 API compatibility page).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Not applicable: egress is free without a cap (price 0), so no separate allowance is defined.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Egress to the Internet is free for all storage classes; no allowance or cap is stated.

price.note: Pricing page: 'There are no charges for egress bandwidth for any storage class'; footnote: egress directly from R2 via the Workers API, S3 API and r2.dev domains is free.

notes: Footnote: other metered Cloudflare services connected to an R2 bucket may charge separately.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use limit on egress is stated on the R2 pricing page.

free_tier.value: Each month free: 10 GB-month storage, 1 million Class A and 10 million Class B operations; Standard storage only, not Infrequent Access.

object_lock.note: Via R2 bucket lock rules (retention per prefix, for a period or indefinitely, set in the dashboard, Wrangler or the API). The S3 Object Lock API (PutObjectLockConfiguration, x-amz-object-lock-* headers) is not supported per the S3 API compatibility page.

s3_endpoints.label: Automatic location
s3_endpoints.note: Docs configure SDKs with only the account endpoint and region 'auto'; the presigned-URL examples produce virtual-hosted URLs (https://my-bucket.<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/...). No path-style requirement is documented. See also https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/presigned-urls/

s3_endpoints.label: EU jurisdiction
s3_endpoints.note: Data location doc: buckets in a jurisdiction must be reached at https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.<JURISDICTION>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; the example uses region 'auto'. This endpoint cannot reach buckets outside the EU jurisdiction.

notes: Unauthorized requests (HTTP 401) are not charged (pricing page FAQ).
